metadataRaw.title: Release Stiff Hips in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the frog rock back exercise, which may help reduce hip tightness and stiffness within seconds.

This easy exercise can be done in bed, requires no equipment, and is a great daily mobility exercise to stretch the hips, pelvis, glutes, and back. 

Let us know how it works for you!
